analyst.summary: SAIL's FY26 print is real (PAT +50.5% YoY, debt down, volumes up) but the Q4 margin spike to a 7-quarter-high 14.31% is driven by a reversible safeguard-duty tailwind and January price hikes, not structural re-rating; layered on a stretched ~20x trailing multiple for a 7.7%-ROE PSU cyclical about to roughly double its capex run-rate (Rs 15,000cr FY27 guided, inside a ~Rs 1,00,000cr plan meant to push leverage toward 1:1 D/E), and with the quant model's own 1-year score already below its Hold line, the call is Sell.
